instruction: Locate and record at least three new large language model papers from arXiv published on October 11, 2023 in the spreadsheet, ensuring you include their titles, PDF links, and publication dates.

parameters.window_name: New Large Language Models.xlsx - LibreOffice Calc

metadata.explanation: Task requires finding and adding at least 3 new LLM papers from arXiv on Oct 11, 2023. Evaluator extracts row content and validates: (1) at least 3 rows exist, (2) at least 3 rows contain 'arxiv' text, and (3) at least 3 rows mention October 11, 2023 date. This ensures added rows are actual arXiv papers from the correct date.

llm_judge_reasons: Semantic logic is sound: Getter correctly extracts column-specific data (title, pdf_link, date) from columns A, B, C and validates structural aspects
Parameter handling is correct: Metric correctly accesses expected.get('min_rows') etc., which is the right pattern for type='rule' (not expected.get('rules'))

Comprehensive coverage: Validates all four main requirements - (1) quantity (>=3 rows), (2) source (arxiv mentions + URL validation), (3) date (Oct 11, 2023), (4) structure (title, PDF link, date columns)
Robust date format handling: Checks multiple date format variations (2023-10-11, Oct 11 2023, October 11, 2023, etc.) making it resilient to different date representations
URL pattern validation implemented: Uses regex pattern to validate proper arxiv.org URLs (arxiv.org/abs/XXXX.XXXXX or arxiv.org/pdf/XXXX.XXXXX) at lines 87-117

Structural validation bonus: Metric prioritizes valid_arxiv_url_count over simple arxiv text mentions, awarding full score (1.0) for proper URLs and slightly reduced score (0.95) for text-only matches
Sensible partial scoring: Provides proportional credit for incomplete requirements (row count 25%, arxiv 35%, dates 35%, title bonus 5%)
Title validation included: Checks for non-empty titles in column A and awards bonus points for complete title coverage
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider adding column header validation: Verify that expected column headers (Title, PDF Link, Date) exist to ensure proper data organization, though current column-based extraction (A, B, C) is reasonable
Minor: Could add more strict validation that ONLY rows with valid arXiv URLs count, but current approach with prioritization is acceptable and handles edge cases well
